name: fatrat-webext
description: Send links to the FatRat download manager from the browser's context menu.

scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build -s dist/chrome -a dist/packages -n fatrat-chrome-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build -s dist/firefox -a dist/packages -n fatrat-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.start:firefox: npm run build && web-ext run -s dist/firefox
